import datetime,json,math,os,hashlib,traceback
from pathlib import Path
import torch
from safetensors.torch import load_file
from scripts.summarize_seed import summarize
root=Path('/mount-data/GRPO-Sequence-Ratio/runs/seed43')
out=root/'acceptance-v1'
torch.set_num_threads(4)
try:
 result=summarize(root)
 checks=[]
 tokens=[]
 for run in result['runs']:
  p=Path(run['directory'])
  ck=p/f"checkpoint-{run['rounds']:03d}"
  state=torch.load(ck/'training_state.pt',map_location='cpu',weights_only=False)
  entries=state['optimizer']['state']
  ts=[v for st in entries.values() for v in st.values() if torch.is_tensor(v)]
  assert all(torch.isfinite(t).all().item() for t in ts)
  adapter=load_file(str(ck/'adapter_model.safetensors'),device='cpu')
  assert all(torch.isfinite(t).all().item() for t in adapter.values())
  assert state['round']==run['rounds'] and state['updates']==run['rounds']*16
  assert state['scheduler']['last_epoch']==state['updates']
  keys=['python_rng','numpy_rng','torch_rng','cuda_rng','schedule_rng','schedule_orders']
  assert all(k in state for k in keys)
  checks.append({'directory':str(p),'checkpoint':str(ck),'round':state['round'],'updates':state['updates'],'optimizer_parameters':len(entries),'optimizer_tensors':len(ts),'optimizer_finite':True,'adapter_tensors':len(adapter),'adapter_finite':True,'scheduler_epoch':state['scheduler']['last_epoch'],'rng_schedule_present':True})
  del state,adapter,ts,entries
  parts={}
  for phase,files in [('training',sorted(p.glob('rollout-*.json'))),('validation',sorted(p.glob('validation-*-predictions.json'))),('test',[p/'test-final-predictions.json'])]:
   acc={'files':len(files),'sequences':0,'input_tokens_per_sequence':0,'input_tokens_per_prompt':0,'output_tokens':0}
   for f in files:
    records=json.loads(f.read_text())
    acc['sequences']+=len(records)
    acc['input_tokens_per_sequence']+=sum(len(x['prompt_ids']) for x in records)
    acc['output_tokens']+=sum(len(x['token_ids']) for x in records)
    stride=8 if phase=='training' else 1
    assert len(records)%stride==0
    for i in range(0,len(records),stride):
     assert all(x['prompt_ids']==records[i]['prompt_ids'] for x in records[i:i+stride])
     acc['input_tokens_per_prompt']+=len(records[i]['prompt_ids'])
   parts[phase]=acc
  assert parts['training']['files']==run['rounds']
  assert parts['training']['output_tokens']==run['training_generated_tokens']
  assert parts['test']['sequences']==6965
  tokens.append({'environment':run['environment'],'operator':run['operator'],'phases':parts,'input_tokens_per_sequence':sum(v['input_tokens_per_sequence'] for v in parts.values()),'input_tokens_per_prompt':sum(v['input_tokens_per_prompt'] for v in parts.values()),'output_tokens':sum(v['output_tokens'] for v in parts.values())})
 final={'verified_at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'summary':result,'state_checks':checks,'token_usage':tokens,'token_scope':'Exact lengths from every saved formal rollout, validation and final test prediction. Sequence input counts repeat each training prompt for its eight completions. Prompt input counts once per generation request prompt, without claiming physical cache/prefill work. Outputs include thinking. HF forward/backward repeated token processing and historical Node01 pilots are excluded.'}
 (out/'RESULT.json').write_text(json.dumps(final,indent=2)+'\n')
 (out/'EXIT.json').write_text(json.dumps({'code':0,'time':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()})+'\n')
except BaseException:
 (out/'FAILURE.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc())
 (out/'EXIT.json').write_text(json.dumps({'code':1,'time':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()})+'\n')
 raise
